[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cardiovascular training includes warm-up, high-intensity interval training (HIIT), steady-state cardio, and cool-down.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Strength training includes lower body exercises (squats, lunges, calf raises), core exercises (plank, Russian twists), and upper body exercises (push-ups, incline dumbbell press).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Progressive overload involves increasing intensity or duration of cardio workouts by 10-15% every two weeks and increasing weight or reps in strength training exercises by 2.5-5lbs or 2-3 reps every two weeks.
